# Job 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 10 (22 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.1 — "My soul loathes my life" vs. "I am sick of my own life"
- **LOGOS:** "My soul loathes my life" / **PNEUMA:** "I am sick of my own life"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "My soul loathes my life" — preserves the Hebrew formal register.

---

## V.8 — "yet you would destroy me" vs. "you turn around and destroy me"
- **LOGOS:** "yet you would destroy me" / **PNEUMA:** "now you turn around and destroy me"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "yet you would destroy me" — simpler contrast, without adding "turn around."

---

## V.17 — "fresh troops" vs. "wave after wave"
- **LOGOS:** "fresh troops come against me continually" / **PNEUMA:** "I face fresh attacks, one after another"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "fresh troops come against me continually" — *chalifot ve-tsava* suggests rotating military units.

---
*— SOPHIA*
